model: Five isolated nonmetal band-edge calculations have DIFFERENT arbitrary internal energy zeros. For each record E_relative_vacuum=E_relative_internal-(E_vacuum-E_internal). Use the declared ideal vacuum-level lineup with no interface dipole,band bending,chemical reaction,strain or charge-induced reconstruction. The actual interface would need separate evidence.
target: For each pair report whether a positive common forbidden energy interval exists,and its width (zero if no positive overlap). For an electron injected into the two isolated conduction edges,its favored material has the LOWER vacuum-referenced CBM;for a hole at the valence edges,its favored material has the HIGHER vacuum-referenced VBM. Determine the electron/hole material IDs for each pair and select all pairs with a positive common gap AND separated favored electron/hole materials. A broken-gap alignment does not pass this isolated-band carrier-separation screen.
reporting: Return vacuum-referenced[VBM,CBM]rows in source record order,common-gap widths and carrier IDs in pair order,and admissible pair IDs encoded by joining the source pair with|. All comparisons are exact for the supplied numbers. Equal individual band gaps do not establish equal absolute band edges.
